source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ας Μαΐου — «Άγιος Κόδρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives one sentence and a distich and nothing else. He is none of the corpus's other men of this name: `quadratus-the-apostle` is of the Seventy and kept on 21 September, `quadratus-of-corinth` is the physician martyred with Cyprian and Dionysius, and the Codratus of Nicomedia on the Greek 7 May was beheaded after the proconsul Perinios dragged him through three cities. This one dies on 22 May, dragged along the ground by wild horses, and the page gives him no place, no year and no companions. No hymn, no relics.
